milestones.note: The owners wrote to the Public Service Commission of Wisconsin on October 28, 2026 to cancel both approvals.

Status.note:
The owners have cancelled the Nemadji Trail project, so the status stays cancelled.

What the sources say:
- Open the owners' letter at https://www.wpr.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/viewdoc.pdf and read page 1. It is dated October 28, 2026 and is headed 'Cancellation of Project'. It says 'they are cancelling the CPCN's granted in Docket Nos. 9698-CE-100 and 9698-CE-101' and 'No construction has occurred'.
- A POWER Magazine article from November 3, 2026 at https://www.powermag.com/groups-cancel-1-billion-gas-fired-power-plant-project-in-wisconsin/ is headed 'Groups Cancel $1-Billion Gas-Fired Power Plant Project in Wisconsin' and reports the same cancellation. It is a separate publisher from the owners.
- A Wisconsin Public Radio article at https://www.wpr.org/news/owners-pull-plug-proposed-natural-gas-plant-in-northern-wisconsin is a third report with the title 'owners pull plug proposed natural gas plant in northern wisconsin'.

Stale listings:
- The Environmental Integrity Project page at https://oilandgaswatch.org/facility/rec_d4f1u5oq7easr8ra1fm0 still says proposed. Its page is drawn by scripts and the text did not load, so it is not cited. Its date of July 2026 is before the cancellation, so it is out of date.
- The Sierra Club planned list is reference only and is not cited.

qa.question: Should the 2027 start year be cleared on the cancelled Nemadji Trail unit?
qa.finding: The owners cancelled the project on October 28, 2026 with no construction done. The unit is cancelled but still shows a start year of 2027.
qa.recommendation: Clear the start year, because the manual says cancelled units never carry one.
qa.note: Open the owners' letter at https://www.wpr.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/viewdoc.pdf, page 1, headed 'Cancellation of Project'.

qa.question: Is EIA plant 8057 Superior Generation Energy Center the same project as Nemadji Trail?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026, sheet 'Canceled or Postponed', has plant code 8057, 'Superior Generation Energy Center', Douglas County, owner entity ALLETE, Inc., generator GEN1, 170 MW, natural gas fired combustion turbine, about 0.9 km from GEM's point. The 170 MW and single combustion turbine do not match the 625 MW combined cycle unit.
qa.recommendation: Do not link plant 8057 to this unit, since it looks like an older ALLETE proposal on the same site. Ask the project manager before typing any EIA code.
qa.note: Plant code 8057, generator ID GEN1. Nemadji Trail has no EIA code. The file is https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx.

qa.question: Is there a document that states Backup Power for the Nemadji Trail unit?
qa.finding: I searched the owners' cancellation letter, the news reports and the power-technology.com profile. None says anything about backup power. The plant was a grid power station, not a data center.
qa.recommendation: Leave Backup Power as no. I looked in the owners' letter and news coverage and found no statement either way.

qa.question: Should the Environmental Integrity Project and Sierra Club proposed listings be treated as stale?
qa.finding: Both list the plant as proposed or planned, but the owners' letter of October 28, 2026 cancels it.
qa.recommendation: Leave the status as cancelled. Neither listing is cited.
